description: A finance director must sign off on a regional branch-closure budget and set the required employee-transition reserve, lease-exit escrow, landlord-consent condition, and total funding requirement, with input from HR finance and legal.

shared_context.S1: The company plans to close one regional branch during the next financial quarter.
shared_context.S2: The draft closure budget totals $3,200,000, including a $600,000 employee-transition reserve and $2,600,000 of other closure costs.
shared_context.S3: Mara makes the binding decision on whether the closure budget can be signed off.
shared_context.S4: At the weekly capital-allocation meeting, Mara reviews the HR finance and legal checks, updates the draft figures as needed, and signs off on the corrected closure budget when the required checks are complete.

PF1.text: While reconciling the personnel file this week, Jon confirmed that 18 affected employees are covered by the transition plan and that the approved calculation requires a total employee-transition reserve of exactly $1,140,000; the draft budget still reflects the earlier $600,000 estimate and Jon has not yet updated the budget workbook.

PF2.text: Elena received the executed branch lease memo this morning confirming that exit requires landlord consent and an escrow payment of exactly $420,000, equal to six months of rent; the lease memo has not yet been attached to the approval packet.

acceptance_conditions: The closure budget must be signed off.
The employee-transition reserve must be exactly $1,140,000.
The lease-exit escrow must be exactly $420,000.
Landlord consent must be required before the branch lease is exited.
The total funded budget must be exactly $4,160,000.

content_checks.C7: decisions['lease_exit_escrow_usd'] == 420000 and decisions['landlord_consent_required'] == True and decisions['total_funded_budget_usd'] == 4160000

decisive_facts.why: PF1 changes employee_transition_reserve_usd from the draft $600,000 to exactly $1,140,000 and raises total_funded_budget_usd from $3,200,000 to $3,740,000 before the lease escrow is added.
PF2 changes lease_exit_escrow_usd from $0 to exactly $420,000, changes landlord_consent_required to true, and raises total_funded_budget_usd to exactly $4,160,000.
